title: Business insurance: liability, errors & omissions, cyber
summary: Coverage scaled to your specific risk profile. Don't over-buy, but don't skip what your work actually requires.
detailsHtml:
General liability

Covers third-party bodily injury or property damage related to your business operations. Typically required if you visit client sites or have client visits to your space. $1M/$2M coverage runs $400–$800/year for most service businesses.

Professional liability / errors & omissions

Covers claims that your professional work caused financial harm to a client. Essential for consultants, developers, designers, advisors, and anyone whose deliverable could be claimed defective. Pricing varies widely with profession ($500/year for low-risk consulting, $5,000+/year for high-risk advisory work).

Cyber liability

Covers data breach notification costs, ransomware response, and third-party damages from compromise of client data. Increasingly required by larger clients before they will contract with you. $1M coverage runs $500–$2,000/year for small businesses without large data exposure.
